preregistration.design: DESIGN_PANEL decision-making-6 with both judges' fixes
preregistration.label: L1
preregistration.secondary_tf: 5minute (reported as underpowered: median 2 SETUPs per active session)
preregistration.null_primary: N1: outcomes permuted within session x hour_bin cells, positions fixed, ledger recomputed from the permuted sequence
preregistration.p_definition: doubled tail against the permutation distribution: p = min(1, 2 min(p_lo, p_hi)), p_lo = (1 + #{stat* <= stat}) / (1 + draws), p_hi likewise for >=; the naive (1 + #{|stat*| >= |stat|}) / (1 + draws) is reported as p_abs_ref only (the N1 distribution is off centre: the ledger grows with the clock)
preregistration.p_definition_history: the doubled-tail form replaced the naive form after a 50-draw timing probe on 1 min / L1 (before any full run); no other definition changed
preregistration.multiplicity: Holm over the 7 tests per null per timeframe
preregistration.decision: branch B iff min Holm p under N1 (L1) < 0.05 on that timeframe; else no key, no ledger row
preregistration.rule: absorbing: skip once the ledger at the bar has >= k stops or running-min net <= L; rearm variant re-arms at the next SETUP after a skipped SETUP's paper trade wins, counters reset
preregistration.fold_selection: max diff among cells with kept_share >= 0.2; tie -> larger kept share

preregistration_repair.label: L1 (L0: N4 robustness only)

issues.I1: N1 mis-specified: positions are generated by outcomes (duration tied to outcome); rejection reproducible with zero memory
issues.I2: session-matched random control is a hindsight-biased comparator for within-session sequential rules
issues.I3: Judge 2's hour interaction not run after the as-run rejection

preregistration_repair.generator: memoryless: real session skeleton (first SETUP bar, 15:25 cut), outcome iid from the hour_bin pool of real IS units, duration of the drawn unit (variant: independent draw), empirical within-session gaps
preregistration_repair.N3: the 7 statistics on 2,000 memoryless streams (tied duration): doubled-tail p of the observed statistic, Holm over 7
preregistration_repair.N4: primary: within-hour_bin stratified contrasts across sessions (OLS with hour fixed effects weights n_a n_b / (n_a + n_b); partial Spearman on within-hour demeaned ranks); stationary block bootstrap of active sessions (mean block 10, 2,000 draws), doubled-tail p against 0, Holm over 7; 30-min strata as sensitivity; L0 as robustness
preregistration_repair.decision: memory claimed iff N4 and N3 both reject at Holm 5% on L1 with agreeing signs; one -> inconclusive (not shown); neither -> no session memory shown; branch B rows re-judged on hindsight-free statistics in every case

hour_cells.note: the one data-informed choice; counted as trials

preregistration_repair.family: 48 cells; nested / CPCV choice with the pre-registered criterion (max pooled diff | kept_share >= 0.20); PBO / SPA / effective trials over 48; DSR n_trials 48; go_no_go as computed and without the control check
preregistration_repair.control_pct: reported, never used as evidence for or against a sequential rule (I2)
preregistration_repair.calibration: per cell: observed pooled diff vs the memoryless distribution (percentile, doubled-tail p); within-hour stratified kept-vs-skipped diff with session-block bootstrap CI / p and its memoryless percentile; diagnostics only
preregistration_repair.n1_demonstration: N1 (2,000 draws) on 100 tied + 100 independent-duration memoryless streams per timeframe, with the k=2/L=none control percentile (2,000 draws); synthetic, no ledger row

headline: No session memory beyond the hour effect is shown on either timeframe (1 min: NOT REJECTED under N3 or N4, min Holm p N4 1.0000, N3 1.0000; 5 min: INCONCLUSIVE: exactly one hindsight-free null rejects (or signs disagree), N3 min Holm p 0.0070 on stops>=3 with 18 units, N4 min Holm p 0.4198, underpowered). The as-run N1 rejection is an artifact of outcome-dependent trade duration (a memoryless generator reproduces it on 100% of streams). The 48-cell stop-rule family fails go/no-go with and without the control check (nested OOF diff -52.05, CPCV p5 -80.12, PBO 0.8248); no key.

flags_for_orchestrator: harness.go_no_go's control_pct>=95 check is uninformative for any sequential (position-order) rule: the session-matched control conditions on the realized N_s; a causal comparator (random stopping rule with matched per-session stop counts, or a memoryless generator) is needed for such rules

S49 / REPORT.md (outside this study's write scope): record 'no session memory shown beyond the hour effect (N3/N4 min Holm p 1.0 on 1 min); the as-run N1 rejection is an artifact of outcome-dependent trade duration; no key' and the withdrawal of the as-run 'mean-reverting memory' statement, its direction, the N1 excess numbers and the 'reverse rule' follow-up

5 min repaired decision is 'INCONCLUSIVE: exactly one hindsight-free null rejects (or signs disagree)': N3 alone rejects on stops>=3 (18 units, Holm p 0.0070), N4 does not (min Holm p 0.4198); nothing claimed, the sign is positive (not a stop rule's direction); more 5 min sessions, not another statistic, would resolve it

S49 observation (not a test): real sessions with a winner end sooner than the memoryless generator predicts (P(another unit follows | win) real vs memoryless in timeframes.minute.mechanism); session structure lives in the count of later SETUPs, not in the outcome given the ledger
caveats: IS only; nothing was read from OOS beyond row counts
the as-run N1 / N2 permutation tests are kept as the record only; they do not test session memory (positions fixed while generated by outcomes)

the memoryless generator is a null model, not a fit: ~6% more units per stream than the data and a higher P(another unit follows | win); session structure in the SETUP count is an observation for S49, not tested here
the pooled kept-vs-skipped diff of every grid cell is inside the memoryless distribution (hour composition plus cost avoidance); the session-matched control percentile is not used for this family
active_from_hour_bin=13 is the one data-informed choice of the repair and is counted in the 48-cell family

5 min has median 2 SETUPs per active session: no test has power there; its repaired decision is 'INCONCLUSIVE: exactly one hindsight-free null rejects (or signs disagree)' (N3 alone rejects on stops>=3, 18 units; N4 does not; the pre-registered rule needs both)
the rearm variant's winner is the paper trade of a skipped SETUP
